summary: Add a top-level paid-organic-overlap command joining live paid search terms against a Google Search Console export.
reason: This read-only cross-CLI workflow composes one googleAds:search GAQL read with a Google Search Console query export passed via --gsc-file (no second-binary call, no new HTTP), normalizes query keys, dedupes organic rows to best position, and surfaces terms paid for that already rank organically.
